Output Files Overview

Introduction

This section describes the generated output files, their structure, data content, and visual representations.

Directory Structure

outputs/
├── energies.dat
├── frequencies.csv
├── extrapolation_summary.txt
├── plots/
│   ├── hf_extrapolation.png
│   └── correlation_extrapolation.png

File Descriptions

energies.dat

  • Format:
